title: Mixed Event — Smile of a Dreamer — Episode3 Even If That's "Ideal"

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime picks up the pace in preparation for their final Show Contest performance! At the same time, Emu learns that her brothers are working on a huge overhaul of Phoenix Wonderland. She tries to convince them to reconsider, but will she be successful?

rows.Line: The next day
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, we're making a decision today!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone. Will you be continuing your discussion regarding your program today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We are. Especially since we couldn't agree on anything or reach a consensus...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Where's Emu?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu said she has to deal with something at home.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, okay. That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I would've liked to see Emu too, but if she's busy then we'll just have to let her be...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And since our discussion kept reaching dead ends, it may've been nice to have her unique ideas maybe break open a path for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, we just have to choose something that she can enjoy to her heart's content!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's start our discussion once more!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-You're all too stubborn...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*... You're one to talk. You just keep saying, This! It has to be this! Like a broken record...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And once again we're all running in different directions. How about we ask how the plushies feel and vote on which idea is the best?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay then... Is that why you were playing with them the other time?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing like that. I was purely having a little fun with them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your tricks won't work here, Rui! You'll just have to fight fair and square!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, woe is me...! To be seen in such a manner! It is as if my heart is being torn to pieces...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Quit hamming it up. You're not fooling us...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, hi there!
You're here already!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Len, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? Is Emu not with you today...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Emu's taking the day off...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A day off? So something really did happen to her?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really happened...?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, we found Emu all by herself yesterday and she had this sad expression on her face.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! She's always happy and smiling, so she sort of shocked us yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu? Sad?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Maybe she dropped that taiyaki she brought as a snack on accident?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, if that were the case she'd come crying to me while saying, Neneee! Help!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So something more serious happened...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then we may want to ask her during our next practice. I'd like to help her if she really is in trouble.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right, I'm all for that...! If I can, I as the troupe leader shall lend her a hand as well!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's already getting dark. We must've been talking for a pretty long time.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Lights ON. Please watch your step.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's finally starting to get warmer, but the sun still goes down relatively early.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right. We need to make sure that we're taking good care of ourselves too. After we all get home, we should...
Enough...!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Who was that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Someone with a lot of anger in their voice it seems.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Maybe a fight broke out in the park? We should go see...!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What do you mean rethink this partnership?! We're about to finalize everything, you know...?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Do you not understand how much money is changing hands over this deal?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Your pathetic ideas pale in comparison with what we're trying to achieve!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I want to keep the promise I made with grandpa...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If the Trampoline Dome isn't getting that many visitors, I'll work hard so that it will!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone at the Wonder Stage even came up with an idea to make it more fun and attractive!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That way, more people will come and play, and they'll be laughing and smiling. Grandpa's PXL can stay the way it is and we'll get more visitors!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You just don't get it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I came up with other ideas to get more visitors line up for the rides and attractions that are already here! Like...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Emu. This is our job. You are in no position to interfere.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And we believe that this partnership is what's best for this park.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Stop! Just stop!!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Why do you care about smiles and laughter so much?! That sort of thinking is what brought this park down to where it is now in the first place!!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Exactly. Business is about results. I suggest that you free yourself from these ideals of yours...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait... Is that Emu?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But those two men in the suits... Who are they?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? You guys...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's going on? Are you in trouble?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, well...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Just who are you two?
Why are you yelling at her?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Who? We're her family!
Don't butt in where you're not supposed to!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Family...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, then that makes you her elder brothers?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As members of the same troupe as Emu, we were hoping to get to know you but...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Troupe...? Oh, you mean for the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Heh. That piece of junk...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What was that...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: So it was you lot then. If it weren't for you, we'd already be rid of that thing by now...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: If only we succeeded, Emu would've given up and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Take back that part about it being a piece of junk!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Excuse me...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's true that the Wonder Stage is old. So old that it could fall apart at any moment!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that stage is also the main theatre for Wonderlands×Showtime! As the troupe leader, I will not let what you said pass!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Oh? And what does your lowly troupe intend to do then...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you should leave it here for now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're in their employ. This isn't the right time or place to discuss this...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hah. At least this one seems to have his head on straight.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I'll tell you this as a courtesy. No good will come of you as long as you are involved with my idiot sister here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What are you suggesting...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: She refuses to face reality, and constantly has her head in the clouds.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: She's always been like this. Be it trying to fly, catch a rainbow and so on, she's been living in her dream world. Not only that, the ones she gets involved all end up getting hurt in the end.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Emu. Keep your dreams to yourself. We're through dealing with you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hold on...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You no longer have any hopes or dreams...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What was that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Such a pity. That also explains why you can't comprehend someone who has these sorts of ideals.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Or is it simply too much to bear and you've already given up...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I have no idea what you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then please excuse me. I was only speaking my mind as someone who has also been chasing dreams.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed, believing in a dream can be a rather perilous endeavor.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But fear not. Your younger sister is a renowned master of this art.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She is able to believe in something that all others have long since given up on...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I sincerely hope that you will stop insulting my friends like this.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: R-Rui! Please, it's okay! I'll be fine...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: That's enough, Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We don't have much time ourselves. Our guests will be arriving at any minute.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: But Keisuke...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We're going.
